scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' INT; bun run dev:gateway & bun run dev:server & bun run dev:web & wait
scripts.build: cd packages/shared && bun run build && cd ../web && bun run build && cd ../server && bun run build
scripts.test:bun: cd packages/server && bunx --bun vitest run --config vitest.bun.config.ts
